description: Housekeeping, documentation, and git commit. Update .gitignore, write README.md, verify end-to-end, and create the git commit with the required author email. Independent of FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 in content but must run after both are complete since it finalises and commits everything.
steps:
Step 1 — .gitignore: Add these lines if not already present:
  server/database/prismguard.db
  server/node_modules/
  server/.env
  Keep existing entries. The .env at project root is already ignored.

Step 2 — README.md: Create or overwrite with these sections:
  # PrismGuard — SecureAI Gateway
  Brief description of what PrismGuard does.
  ## Architecture: Frontend (Vite/React/TS) → Backend API (Node.js/Express) → SQLite
  ## Getting Started
  Prerequisites: Node.js 18+
  ```
  npm install
  cd server && npm install && cd ..
  npm run server   # starts backend on :3001
  npm run dev      # starts frontend on :5173 (separate terminal)
  ```
  ## Production build
  ```
  npm run build
  npm start   # serves static dist + API
  ```
  Note: On first run the SQLite database is auto-created and seeded. Subsequent runs preserve existing data.
  ## Database
  Schema: server/database/schema.sql
  Seed data: server/database/seed.sql
  Runtime DB: server/database/prismguard.db (gitignored — regenerated from seed on fresh install)
  ## Security Pipeline
  Describe the 4-layer pipeline: Keyword Filter → Secure AI API → PrismGuard → Resource Model.
  ## API Endpoints
  List all routes with method and path: GET /api/dashboard/stats, GET /api/resources, GET /api/resources/:id, GET /api/prompts, POST /api/prompts, GET /api/models, GET /api/models/:id, PATCH /api/models/:id/version, GET /api/research, GET /api/research/:id, GET /api/admin/reviews, POST /api/admin/reviews/:id/classify, GET /api/training, GET /api/training/models, POST /api/training/retrain, GET /api/security-logs, GET /api/attack-lab/tests, POST /api/attack-lab/test.

Step 3 — Final end-to-end smoke test (manual verification):
  a. Delete server/database/prismguard.db if it exists.
  b. cd server && node index.js — confirm 'Database initialised with seed data'.
  c. curl http://localhost:3001/api/dashboard/stats — confirm JSON.
  d. Kill server, run again — confirm 'Database already exists, skipping seed'.
  e. npm run dev from root — open http://localhost:5173 in browser.
  f. Verify Dashboard KPIs come from DB.
  g. Chat: send blocked prompt, verify DB row inserted.
  h. Admin Review: classify a 'Pending Review' item as 'malicious' — verify training_samples row created.
  i. Models: click Start Retraining on Banking model — verify version increments in DB.
  j. Confirm no TS typecheck errors.

Step 4 — git commit: Stage all changed and new files. Set git user.email to kanishjebamathew.m@gmail.com for this commit. Commit message:
  'feat: replace Supabase with Node.js/Express/SQLite backend

Remove @supabase/supabase-js dependency.
Add server/ with Express, better-sqlite3, schema.sql, seed.sql, security pipeline.
Add src/lib/api.ts typed fetch wrappers.
Proxy /api to :3001 in vite.config.ts.
Connect all 9 screens to live API endpoints with data.ts fallback.
Auto-init SQLite DB on first startup; preserve data on restarts.
Seed: 4 resources, 4 models, 6 attack tests, 5 research topics, 10 prompts, 4 reviews, 10 logs.'

Co-authored-by: kanishjebamathew.m@gmail.com
  Use: git -c user.email=kanishjebamathew.m@gmail.com commit -m '...'
acceptance_criteria: README.md exists and documents setup steps
git log --oneline -1 shows the commit with the correct message
git show --stat shows all expected files (server/ tree, src/lib/api.ts, modified screens, vite.config.ts, package.json, .gitignore, README.md)
verification: cat package.json | grep supabase (must return nothing)
